October 8, 2025 - The Pawsey Supercomputing Centre (PSC) is a government-supported high-performance computing national facility located in Perth, Western Australia. Pawsey supports researchers in Western Australia and across Australia. Pawsey is an unincorporated joint venture between the CSIRO, Curtin University, ...

Named after Australian scientist Dr Joseph Pawsey, one of the pioneers of Australian radio astronomy for his work in the field of interferometry, Pawsey is currently serving over 4000 researchers achieving unprecedented results, in domains such as radio astronomy, energy and resources, engineering, bioinformatics and health sciences.

Welcome to the epicentre of scientific breakthroughs and innovation. At Pawsey, we power discoveries with cutting-edge supercomputing, large-scale data storage, and advanced visualisation right here in Australia. Whether you're curious about nanotechnology, radio astronomy, medical research, high-energy physics, mining, architecture, or beyond – subscribe and join us as we explore the incredible world of data-driven discovery!
